svg.title: SRCNN / Complete experiment evolution
svg.desc: 207 experiments / 217 main links / 100 MHz reference / snapshot 653ceb9. Snapshot 653ceb9. Experiment relationships are not Git ancestry.
svg.text: Thick solid arrows: main optimization relationships. Multiple
parents only where needed; all archive relationships remain
Green: current stage passes with network latency; amber: HLS
timing warning; red: specific problem shown; gray: auxiliary;
Bold: comparable network ms/frame at 100 MHz; red times are
not bold. ~ plus ID: estimate cited from the same design.
Existing HLS/RTL cycles only; no 10 ns synthesis rerun or
board measurement; host/DMA excluded. Green does not
labels state C/PE/layer scope; hover for provenance and

g.title: E000: Original floating-point baseline Preserve src/, network structure, and replicated edges; measure correctness and synthesis scale. Two full intermediate maps exceed BRAM capacity. Correct C simulation does not establish device fit. Over budget: BRAM18K 19,601.14 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,960,113,853 cycles. All archive parents: None Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E010: Layer ranges and bit-width scan Measure ranges on 13 inputs and scan 16/12/10/8-bit weight and activation combinations. 10/10 bits lose about 0.0695 dB average PSNR; 8/8 bits lose about 5.18 dB. Current acceptance covers the complete 13-image course set; comic is not invented. Analysis complete No network latency recorded No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E000 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E011: Real ap_fixed: 16/16 bits Check the software quantization model using AMD data types, with all supplied images planned. C simulation fails. Subsequent retries use separate IDs; this record is not a pass. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E010 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E012: Real ap_fixed: 10/10 bits Validate the butterfly output of the complete fixed-point convolution network. This C simulation fails. Valid E017/E019 checks later establish the numerical evidence. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E010 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E013: Real ap_fixed: 8/8 bits Check agreement between the quantization model and actual fixed-point arithmetic despite the failed quality gate. Arithmetic agreement does not imply acceptable quality; the all-8-bit design remains rejected. C simulation passed C passes; latency unmeasured No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E010 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E014: 16/16-bit full-dataset retry Retry complete ap_fixed simulation across the supplied images. Only some images finish within 45 minutes. Retain the timeout; do not claim a full-dataset pass. Timed out Timed out No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E011 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E018: 16/16-bit single-image control Limit complete ap_fixed arithmetic checks to butterfly; retain E010 as the separate multi-image quality evaluation. Compilation/simulation fails in this attempt; E015 retries it. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E014 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E015: Valid 16/16-bit single-image retry Fix run configuration and validate complete ap_fixed butterfly arithmetic. The pass covers a single-image arithmetic check, not an actual 13-image full-ap_fixed run. C simulation passed C passes; latency unmeasured No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E018 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E016: 8/8-bit single-image retry Recheck narrow arithmetic using an independent configuration. The quality failure still applies; the retry does not relax the PSNR gate. C simulation passed C passes; latency unmeasured No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E013 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E017: 10-bit boundaries and integer reference Use real ap_fixed for input/parameter conversion and layer rounding/saturation; preserve full product and accumulation fractions in integers. Establish an independent precision reference across 13 images. This is numerical evidence, not a performance experiment. C simulation passed C passes; latency unmeasured No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E010 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E019: Complete 10/10-bit ap_fixed retry Check the complete ap_fixed network against the independent integer reference on butterfly, bit for bit. Functionality passes. The hardware architecture still requires separate design and synthesis. C simulation passed C passes; latency unmeasured No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E012 (Retry after a fix); E017 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E049: Exhaustive layer-boundary rounding Exhaust all 25,165,824 states across three 23-bit accumulator boundaries. Validate ties-to-even rounding and saturation. No network latency or resource claim follows. C simulation passed Boundary check; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E017 (Numerical reference or research motivation); E048 (Verify the same design) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E062: Layer-specific INT8 feasibility Try 8-bit weights/activations one layer at a time instead of quantizing the entire network to INT8. Only 8-bit Conv2 weights meet the average quality gate. Actual 8-bit activations and Conv1/Conv3 weights fail. Analysis complete No network latency recorded No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E010 (Numerical reference or research motivation); E017 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.
g.text: Try INT8 one layer at a

g.title: E065: Conv2 8-bit-weight boundary validation Retain 10-bit activations and validate mixed precision on 13 images with real ap_fixed boundaries. Average PSNR loss is about 0.07589 dB. This supplies independent evidence for combinations and C13 T4 across the complete 13-image course set. C simulation passed C passes; latency unmeasured No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E062 (Numerical reference or research motivation); E017 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E066: Complete mixed-precision ap_fixed control Validate mixed-precision butterfly output using the complete ap_fixed network. Bit identity establishes when E065 quality evidence can be used by architectures with the same precision. C simulation passed C passes; latency unmeasured No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E065 (Control experiment); E019 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E071: Packing/Winograd prerequisite ranges Measure raw integer coefficients, transform widths, packed low-field accumulation limits, and paper DSP budgets. Range and budget analysis is not synthesis. New weights require checking the bounds again. Analysis complete No network latency recorded No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E017 (Numerical reference or research motivation); E065 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E020: Default automatic optimization, 10 ns Copy the original and add loop labels without changing computation or full-map storage. Latency and BRAM scale remain close to the original baseline. Over budget: BRAM18K 19,601.14 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,960,113,853 cycles. All archive parents: E000 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E021: Default automatic optimization, 4 ns Tighten only the target period and inspect default scheduling changes. Full intermediate maps still do not fit. A clock target is not an implementation result. Over budget: BRAM18K 42,947.72 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 4,294,771,851 cycles. All archive parents: E020 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E022: Disable automatic pipelining Measure whether default pipeline behavior helps. Resource issues persist and latency increases. Over budget: BRAM18K 44,822.23 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 4,482,223,011 cycles. All archive parents: E020 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E023: Inner-loop pipeline: invalid configuration Attempt to pipeline the innermost MAC loops through configuration. The tool skips the syn.directive key; the result does not measure the intended directive. Over budget: BRAM18K; II target missed; Invalid configuration Invalid configuration No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E020 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E024: Pixel-loop pipeline: invalid configuration Attempt to pipeline the outer pixel loops. The configuration key is invalid. E029 is the subsequent valid control for this idea. Over budget: BRAM18K; II target missed; Invalid configuration Invalid configuration No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E020 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E025: Array partition: invalid configuration Attempt to improve scheduling by adding array ports. The key is invalid; E032 corrects it. Over budget: BRAM18K; II target missed; Invalid configuration Invalid configuration No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E020 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E026: Allow floating-point reassociation Investigate unsafe-math effects on floating-point accumulation scheduling. Network latency improves little and full intermediate maps remain too large. Over budget: BRAM18K 19,601.14 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,960,113,671 cycles. All archive parents: E020 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E027: Change only to 16-bit fixed point Retain the full-map architecture and measure changing data types alone. Storage decreases but still greatly exceeds capacity; LUTs also exceed the budget. Over budget: BRAM18K/LUT 3,912.56 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 391,256,088 cycles. All archive parents: E015 (Design or parameter baseline); E020 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E028: Valid inner-loop pipeline retry Correct the directive key and measure actual innermost pipelining. Floating-point recurrence and full-map storage still limit the design. Over budget: BRAM18K; HLS timing warning 4,556.95 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 455,695,454 cycles. All archive parents: E023 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E029: Valid pixel-loop pipeline retry Correct the key and apply the intended pixel-loop pipeline directives. The fastest valid float control still needs about 11,114 BRAM18K blocks, and not all II targets are met. Over budget: BRAM18K; II target missed 3,811.22 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 381,121,723 cycles. All archive parents: E024 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E032: Valid array-partition retry Correct partition directives and inspect memory-port and pipeline effects. Retaining complete intermediate maps leaves the resource problem unresolved. Over budget: BRAM18K; HLS timing warning 4,556.95 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 455,695,454 cycles. All archive parents: E025 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E030: Floating-point streaming functional control Connect read/pad/Conv1/Conv2/pad/Conv3/write by streams and reuse windows in line buffers. First establish full-image and edge equivalence. This record contains C simulation only. C simulation passed C passes; latency unmeasured No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E000 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E031: 10-bit streaming, T32 Convert the validated stream organization to 10-bit fixed point and T=32 partial unrolling. BRAM18K falls to 168, but multiplier/type logic maps heavily to LUTs, failing resource and estimated timing goals. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning 38.82 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 3,882,221 cycles. All archive parents: E030 (Design or parameter baseline); E017 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E033: T32 single-image synthesis control Shorten the C-simulation workload while retaining the same streaming hardware organization. Again obtain 136,868 LUTs and a 31.822 ns estimate. Inner II=1 does not establish high network throughput. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning 38.82 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 3,882,221 cycles. All archive parents: E031 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E046: Remove redundant accumulator saturation Use archived range bounds to retain complete product precision and quantize only at layer boundaries. An existing synthesis lock blocks this attempt; it is not a hardware measurement. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E033 (Design or parameter baseline); E010 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E063: Accumulator-control retry Measure removal of redundant saturation in a separate run. DSP mapping changes but LUTs remain above budget. Over budget: LUT 29.14 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,913,855 cycles. All archive parents: E046 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E047: Explicit DSP multiplier binding Bind the T32 design's 162/64/25 parallel multipliers to DSPs. Estimated latency decreases substantially, but registered weights and selectors still exceed the LUT budget. Over budget: LUT 29.14 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,913,855 cycles. All archive parents: E033 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E048: Integer carriers for fixed-point arithmetic Store fixed-point raw bits in integers and implement layer rounding explicitly without changing numerical boundaries. The simplified representation still uses about 89,304 LUTs. Banking and selectors need further work. Over budget: LUT 29.14 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,913,855 cycles. All archive parents: E047 (Design or parameter baseline); E017 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E050: Initial Conv3 scatter Reduce across channels before buffering partial sums on the side with fewer channels. BRAM decreases, but initial fixed-point/mapping logic exceeds the LUT budget. Over budget: LUT 38.82 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 3,882,221 cycles. All archive parents: E031 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E060: Integer Conv3 scatter Retain explicit padding and use 32-bit partial sums with rotating line buffers. Resources can meet the budget, but control and extra work make it slower than gather. Candidate; final acceptance pending 37.70 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 3,770,206 cycles. All archive parents: E048 (Design or parameter baseline); E050 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E056: T4 mixed DSP/fabric computation Move some Conv1/Conv3 multipliers into fabric when DSP capacity limits greater parallelism. The paper DSP budget fits, but 237,025 LUTs do not. DSP count alone cannot select a candidate. Over budget: LUT 10.46 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,046,292 cycles. All archive parents: E048 (Design or parameter baseline); E053 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E034: Initial T16 scan Reduce computation rounds per pixel from 32 to 16, increasing parallel multipliers. C simulation fails; E044 retries the design. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E033 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E035: Initial T8 scan Further reduce rounds per pixel to 8. C simulation fails; E045 retries it. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E033 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E044: Valid initial T16 streaming scan Fix simulation settings and measure the same higher-parallelism idea. Default arithmetic/mapping produces a 63.218 ns estimate and excessive LUTs. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning 27.76 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,775,517 cycles. All archive parents: E034 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E045: Valid initial T8 streaming scan Run the initial T8 configuration with valid settings. A 126.008 ns estimate and 266,266 LUTs show that greater parallelism does not accelerate this network. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning 22.22 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,222,165 cycles. All archive parents: E035 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E057: Integer T32 with LUTRAM weight banks Replace fully partitioned weight registers with writable LUTRAM banks matched to parallel ports. LUTs fall to about 44,493, establishing a resource-feasible baseline for further work. Candidate; final acceptance pending 29.83 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,983,024 cycles. All archive parents: E048 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E058: Integer T16 with LUTRAM weight banks Use T16 in the same integer organization to measure the parallelism/resource tradeoff. About 18.7632 ms; this supplies the parameter baseline for clock and unroll-direction scans. Candidate; final acceptance pending 18.76 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,876,320 cycles. All archive parents: E048 (Design or parameter baseline); E057 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E059: Integer T8 with LUTRAM weight banks Increase parallelism again to T8. 85,147 LUTs exceed the project's 70% budget despite remaining DSP capacity. Over budget: LUT 13.23 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,322,968 cycles. All archive parents: E048 (Design or parameter baseline); E058 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E036: T16 Conv1 unroll direction Shift Conv1 parallelism from output channels toward kernel grouping. II misses its target and cycles increase. A provisional label does not imply scheduling success. II target missed 78.94 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 7,894,023 cycles. All archive parents: E058 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E037: T16 Conv2 unroll direction Change Conv2 channel unrolling and its relationship to memory ports. Latency is unchanged and LUT use increases, yielding no better tradeoff. Candidate; final acceptance pending 18.76 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,876,320 cycles. All archive parents: E058 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E038: T16 Conv3 unroll direction Change how Conv3 parallelism splits input channels and kernel computation. DSPs, LUTs, and cycles all increase. Candidate; final acceptance pending 21.55 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,155,352 cycles. All archive parents: E058 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E039: DSP T32 LUTRAM control Measure LUTRAM weight banking in the explicitly DSP-bound design. Establish the first resource-feasible candidate. E070 separately measures physical implementation. Candidate; final acceptance pending 29.83 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,983,024 cycles. All archive parents: E047 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E040: DSP T32 BRAM weight banks Map the same weight banks to BRAM. Many shallow banks waste capacity: 419 BRAM18K blocks exceed the device limit. Over budget: BRAM18K 29.83 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,983,024 cycles. All archive parents: E047 (Design or parameter baseline); E039 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E064: T16 fully partitioned weights Retain T16 but replace banked weights with fully partitioned registers. 88,306 LUTs exceed the project budget. Over budget: LUT 18.07 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,807,151 cycles. All archive parents: E058 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E067: T16 BRAM weight banks Retain T16 and store weights in BRAM. Shallow banks consume 670 BRAM18K blocks, exceeding device capacity. Over budget: BRAM18K 18.76 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,876,320 cycles. All archive parents: E058 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E041: T16 at a 5 ns target Keep precision/storage fixed and inspect scheduling and resources at a tighter period. About 9.7275 ms estimated; the target still requires physical implementation evidence. Candidate; final acceptance pending 19.46 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,945,500 cycles. All archive parents: E058 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E042: T16 at a 4 ns target Tighten the target period again without changing the architecture. About 8.0587 ms estimated; FIFO and per-pixel pipeline overhead remain. HLS timing warning 20.15 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,014,678 cycles. All archive parents: E058 (Design or parameter baseline); E041 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E043: T16 at a 3.33 ns target Continue tightening the target under the same resource and precision budgets. First-round fastest resource-qualified estimate: about 6.9392 ms. This is not board performance. HLS timing warning 20.84 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,083,853 cycles. All archive parents: E058 (Design or parameter baseline); E042 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E051: Ordinary 16x16 multiplier Measure DSP mapping for one signed 16x16 multiplication in isolation. One multiplier maps to one DSP. These PE results are not frame performance. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E047 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E052: Fully unrolled constant weights Fully unroll 64 multiplications by known constants to observe constant optimization. A constant-weight model differs from this project's runtime-loaded weight contract. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E051 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E053: 8x8 fabric multiplier Explicitly measure LUT multiplication and exhaust operand pairs. DSP savings come with LUT costs that accumulate at high parallelism. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E051 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E054: 16x16 multiplier at 4 ns Change only the target period and check that single-DSP mapping persists. Still one DSP per multiplication; this does not validate INT16 packing. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E051 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

E055: Matched addition-only control Use the same array interface/loop to separate interface LUT cost from multiplier cost. The comparison applies to this microkernel; it cannot establish network timing. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E053 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P01: Two shared-input INT8 products Pack two coefficients with gap18, correct borrow for a negative low field, and exhaust signed8 operand triples. Two products use one DSP, with additional unpacking logic compared with the direct control. HLS timing warning PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E051 (Numerical reference or research motivation); E071 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P02: Direct two-product control Compute both products separately with identical interfaces and inputs. Two DSPs provide the matched control for packing's LUT and pipeline costs. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P01 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P03: Unpack after seven terms Accumulate seven packed products within the signed8 safety bound before decoding. Accumulation/decoding costs LUTs and FFs. The seven-term bound does not apply directly to 10-bit inputs. HLS timing warning PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P01 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P04: Automatic packing recognition Remove explicit DSP binding to test compiler recognition of the expression. A successful local mapping does not establish automatic optimal network architecture. HLS timing warning PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P01 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P05: DSP pre-adder builtin Express pre-addition and pipeline stages with the SDK DSP48E2 builtin. P08 must inspect actual primitive attributes; DSP count alone does not prove pre-adder use. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P01 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P06: Nonnegative 10-bit activations, two terms Use shared activations in 0..511, allowing at most two safe low-field accumulations. Retain the range bound. General signed10 inputs cannot reuse this grouping. HLS timing warning PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P01 (Design or parameter baseline); E071 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P07: Exact 10-bit coefficient residual recovery Split coefficients into signed low8 plus a residual scaled by 256, recovering results exactly in fabric. 10-bit quality is preserved, but per-product unpacking and residual recovery add logic. HLS timing warning PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P01 (Design or parameter baseline); E017 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P08: Inspect actual DSP pre-adder mapping After Vivado implementation, inspect DSP48E2 AMULTSEL, ADREG, and related attributes. Evidence concerns this PE's physical mapping, not full SRCNN deployment. Implementation complete; check timing separately Routed timing passes; WNS +2.805 ns PE only; routed timing passes No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P05 (Verify the same design) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.
g.text: Place and route the DSP PE

g.title: P09: Frozen-record reproduction Restore P01 sources, tests, and parameters under a fresh ID to validate reproducibility. A reproduction control introduces no new packing algorithm. HLS timing warning PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P01 (Reproduce the same experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P10: Exact 10-bit packing network, T16 Pack output channels in Conv1/2 and adjacent output pixels in Conv3. DSP use falls, but 101,488 LUTs exceed budget. Per-pixel pipeline overhead remains substantial. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning 30.39 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 3,039,083 cycles. All archive parents: E048 (Design or parameter baseline); P07 (Integrate an existing module) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P11: Exact 10-bit packing network, T8 Increase parallelism with the same arithmetic. 165,606 LUTs exceed budget. Saving multipliers does not resolve selectors and recovery logic. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning 18.94 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,894,302 cycles. All archive parents: P10 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P12: Exact 10-bit packing network, T4 Increase parallelism further and compare time/resource tradeoffs. 292,053 LUTs exceed budget; lower estimated latency cannot qualify this candidate. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning 13.56 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,355,582 cycles. All archive parents: P10 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P13: Complete INT16 two-product control Directly compute two signed16x16 products with matched interfaces and throughput as the new research baseline. Exact C simulation; 2 DSPs, 57 LUTs, 16 FFs, 66 latency/64 interval cycles. PE only; no network latency inference. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E054 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P14: INT16 byte-limb packing Split 16-bit operands, combine packed narrow products, and recover both complete 32-bit results. Exact functionality, but 4 DSPs, 453 LUTs, and 276 FFs cost more than the direct control; DSPs are not saved. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P13 (Control experiment); P01 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P15: INT16 overlapping fields with fabric recovery Allow field overlap and exactly recover both complete products using fabric arithmetic. 1 DSP, 747 LUTs, 200 FFs, and a 3.392 ns estimate; more costly and slower than P16 mixed mapping, with HLS timing warnings. HLS timing warning PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P13 (Control experiment); P01 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

P16: INT16 one-DSP/one-fabric control Directly map one product to DSP and one to LUTs, matching P15's resource types. 1 DSP, 330 LUTs, 16 FFs, and a 2.48 ns estimate beat P15 at the same DSP count. No evidence supports integrating full INT16 packing into the network. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: P13 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

G01: Matched gather control Independently rerun the same T32, 10 ns, 10-bit Conv3 line-buffer organization. This supplies the scatter control; compare all three organizations under identical parameters. Candidate; final acceptance pending 29.83 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,983,024 cycles. All archive parents: E057 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

G02: Scatter with explicit padding Store five rows of 32-bit partial sums while retaining 32-channel padding. BRAM18K falls from 168 to 137, but estimated time rises from 29.83 to 37.70 ms. Candidate; final acceptance pending 37.70 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 3,770,206 cycles. All archive parents: E060 (Design or parameter baseline); G01 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

G03: Scatter with merged boundary kernels Merge repeated taps for nine boundary classes and remove the wide-channel padding buffer. BRAM18K falls further to 87, but kernel selection, loading, and control increase estimated time to about 44.14 ms. Candidate; final acceptance pending 44.14 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 4,413,926 cycles. All archive parents: G02 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

S01: Global-array DDR interface probe Attempt to export AXI ports for global scratch arrays and examine layer-to-layer external storage. scratch1/2 ports are not generated; storage remains enormous on-chip arrays. This is not a valid DDR implementation. Over budget: BRAM18K; Invalid configuration Invalid configuration No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E048 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

S02: Whole-network dataflow control Reuse the matched gather design as the network control for tile fusion. This remeasures the same design rather than introducing a different network. Candidate; final acceptance pending 29.83 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 2,983,024 cycles. All archive parents: G01 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

S03: Three-layer fused output tiles, B8 Recompute each tile's halo, fuse local Conv1/2 computation, and buffer a small Conv2 tile. BRAM is low, but halo recomputation, banking, and address selection cost time and LUTs. Over budget: LUT 228.04 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 22,803,545 cycles. All archive parents: E048 (Design or parameter baseline); S02 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

S04: Three-layer fused output tiles, B16 Increase tile size to reduce relative halo recomputation. Sequential tiles still lack whole-network engine overlap; LUTs exceed budget. Over budget: LUT 167.54 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 16,753,977 cycles. All archive parents: S03 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

S05: Three-layer fused output tiles, B32 Increase output tile size again to compare buffer and recomputation costs. Traffic lower bounds improve, but synthesized latency and LUT use remain unacceptable. Over budget: LUT 141.66 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 14,166,377 cycles. All archive parents: S03 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

S06: Three-layer fused output tiles, B64 Scan the largest tile, including actual replicated edges and incomplete boundary tiles. A smaller halo ratio still does not offset control/storage costs. Bandwidth is modeled, not measured on board. Over budget: LUT 129.82 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 12,981,873 cycles. All archive parents: S03 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W01: 10-bit integer F(2x2,3x3) PE Use G2=2G for integer transforms and divide the inverse result exactly by four before quantization. Local multiplication falls, but transform adders, width growth, reordering, and network scheduling are not yet included. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E071 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W02: Direct-convolution PE control Use the same tile to compare 36 direct products against Winograd's 16. DSP savings accompany higher LUT use. PE cycles are not frame latency. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: W01 (Control experiment) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W03: 16-bit Winograd PE Increase input/weight widths and measure mapping of transformed 18x20-bit products. A Winograd primitive passes; this establishes neither INT16 packing nor a deployed 16-bit network. Local experiment passed PE only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: W01 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W04: Winograd Conv1 layer, T16 Split the 9x9 kernel into nine 3x3 kernels, transform weights at runtime, and reorder tile outputs. Dimension macros F2/F3 collide with AMD header identifiers; compilation fails. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: E048 (Design or parameter baseline); W01 (Integrate an existing module) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W05: Winograd network, T16 Connect Winograd Conv1 to Conv2/3 and measure the complete frame. The same header collision prevents valid synthesis results. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: W04 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W06: Winograd network, T8 Change parallelism while retaining the numerical contract. Compilation still fails. W09 independently retries the design. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: W05 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W07: Single-layer header-order fix Include AMD type headers before defining network dimension macros. Valid layer results emerge, but conditional tile loops inflate HLS's computation iteration estimate. Candidate; final acceptance pending Layer only; no network latency No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: W04 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W08: T16 network header fix Fix include order in an independent source copy. About 22.8954 ms; legal and exact, with substantial tile scheduling and buffering costs. HLS timing warning 57.24 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 5,723,851 cycles. All archive parents: W05 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W09: T8 network header fix Apply the same fix at T8 parallelism. 135,496 LUTs exceed budget; runtime transform loading has costly selectors and registers. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning 34.94 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 3,493,579 cycles. All archive parents: W06 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W10: Fixed tile loops, continuous Conv1 only Separate window generation from a fixed-count MAC loop to remove conditional-boundary iteration inflation. About 7.5482 ms and 241 BRAM18K blocks. Conv2/3 still have per-pixel pipeline overhead. HLS timing warning 18.87 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,887,051 cycles. All archive parents: W08 (Design or parameter baseline); F03 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W11: Three continuous layers, T8, 4 ns Extend continuous scheduling to the other layers and scan T8. C simulation is exact, but Conv3's 8000-bit stream exceeds the tool's 4096-bit limit. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: W10 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W12: Three continuous layers, T16, 4 ns Measure continuous three-layer organization at T16. The same stream-width limit causes synthesis failure; numerical precision is not the failure. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: W10 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W13: Three continuous layers, T8, 3.33 ns Tighten the period for the same continuous organization. Stream width remains invalid, so no performance result is obtained. Run failed Run failed No valid network latency recorded in this experiment. All archive parents: W11 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W14: T8 dual 4000-bit window streams Split each complete Conv3 window into two synchronized channels without changing arithmetic. Legal synthesis estimates about 2.1302 ms, but LUT/FF budgets are exceeded. Over budget: LUT/FF; HLS timing warning 5.33 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 532,562 cycles. All archive parents: W11 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W15: T16 split-window streams Correct the T16 stream representation. About 4.2274 ms, but 89,114 LUTs still exceed the project budget. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning 10.57 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,056,850 cycles. All archive parents: W12 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W16: T8 split-window streams, 3.33 ns Fix stream width and measure the tighter period. The 1.7735 ms estimate exceeds LUT/FF budgets and cannot qualify as a candidate. Over budget: LUT/FF; HLS timing warning 5.33 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 532,569 cycles. All archive parents: W13 (Retry after a fix) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W17: T8 narrow raw-weight banks Reduce channel banking for raw weights used only by sequential transforms; retain transformed MAC banks. LUTs decrease substantially but remain at 93,166, above budget. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning 5.33 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 532,562 cycles. All archive parents: W14 (Design or parameter baseline); W09 (Numerical reference or research motivation) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W18: T16 narrow raw-weight banks Measure the same loader/banking adjustment at T16. About 4.2274 ms, 326 DSPs, and 74,480 LUTs meet this route's resource budget. Final RTL/implementation remain pending. HLS timing warning 10.57 ms/frame Current experiment: HLS top-level latency estimate 1,056,850 cycles. All archive parents: W15 (Design or parameter baseline) Reference: existing cycles at 100 MHz (10 ns), excluding host/DMA transfers. No 10 ns synthesis rerun or board measurement. C/RTL passes do not establish routed timing.

W19: Private parameter streams for Winograd T8 Integrate the selected private loader into W17: one converter supplies three layer streams, preserving integer Winograd, continuous tiles, and exact output encoding.
